Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor security review (SOC 2 + SIG), we need to review Redwood's latest third-party security assessment for the service you run for customers. Specifically: 

- Executive summary of the most recent external security assessment / vulnerability scan (high & critical findings and remediation status)
- The full detailed technical report (including test steps and affected hostnames/IPs) under NDA only

Attached is our standard vendor NDA and the vendor questionnaire snapshot. Can you confirm whether you can share a redacted exec summary for now while we get the NDA processed? If possible we'd like a short remediation status line for any criticals (e.g., patched/mitigated/date).

Timeline: would you be able to provide the redacted summary within 48 business hours? If you require our NDA to be signed first, please let me know and we can route it to legal.

Thanks,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the NDA. We're happy to help and can follow a two-step approach that many of our customers use:

1) Share an executive summary redacted for sensitive operational details (hostnames, IPs, exact config snippets, and internal staff names). This doc will include the finding severity, short non-technical description, and current remediation status (patching/migration/mitigation + date).

2) Provide the detailed technical appendix (test steps, PoCs, asset identifiers) only after an approved NDA and a secure transfer (DocuSign + secure portal access).

Estimated timeline: Exec summary (redacted) — ~2 business days after we confirm redaction scope; Full report — will require NDA review and countersign (typically 7–10 business days depending on legal).

I'll attach a redacted example exec summary and our standard counterproposal for the NDA so your legal team can review. @Priya and @Vivek — looping you in to confirm the redaction baseline and signoff path.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SecAssess_ExecSummary_v1-redacted.pdf (PDF, 120 KB), Redwood_NDA_Counterproposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)

Neha — thanks, that's helpful.

Acme would accept a redacted exec summary that excludes hostnames/IPs, config snippets, and internal employee names. We do need the following detail in the exec summary:
- Clear severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and short summary for each high/critical finding
- Remediation status for each (Patched / Mitigated / In progress) with dates where available
- Any compensating controls put in place if the fix is in progress

For the full technical appendix we will require your countersigned NDA. I'm attaching our NDA; I've also sent it to Legal. Can you confirm you can countersign within 48 hours? If Redwood prefers to propose edits, please highlight them in the DocuSign comments.

Also, can you provide a one-paragraph statement of current remediation progress for the two critical items called out in the summary? That will help our risk team triage while we wait for the full report.

Regards,
Sarah

Vivek / Priya — forwarding Acme's request and legal template. Key asks: redacted exec summary (acceptable) + full report post-NDA. My recommended approach:

- Exec summary: redact hostnames/IPs, kube/node identifiers, and any employee names. Include severity, short findings, remediation status and dates.
- For the two critical items, include a concise remediation status line (what was done and when; e.g., "Patched 2026-05-12: fixed CVE-XXXX-YYYY in image build, rollout completed 05/14").
- Countersign NDA with our standard minimal edits: clause clarifying that sharing the full report does not waive our right to redact operationally sensitive artifacts; require secure portal access rather than emailing attachments.

Attaching our proposed counters to send back to Acme. If you see any legal risks in the NDA as-is, flag them and I'll pause. Otherwise I'd like to return a countersigned DocuSign link + redacted exec summary to Sarah by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Neha

Thanks Neha. Reviewed Acme's NDA and Redwood's counterproposal. Legal is comfortable with the proposed edits — main points:

- We will countersign but add a short clause that the technical appendix will only be made available under the agreed NDA and via our secure portal (no email attachments).
- Redaction baseline approved: hostnames, IP addresses, exact config snippets, and employee names can be redacted. We should retain CVE identifiers and high-level descriptions (no reproduction steps).
- Provide remediation status (Patched / Mitigated / Scheduled) with dates for critical/high findings.

Operationally: once Acme accepts our counters, send them a DocuSign countersigned copy and provide secure portal access. Recommend we also include a short non-disclosure note users must acknowledge before downloading the appendix.

I can sign the NDA via DocuSign — please send the updated DocuSign envelope with our counters.
